<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court expansion:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed a bill to increase the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges from 34 to 38, including the Chief Justice of India, amid ongoing Opposition disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQQnlORV9Oc3lJTlBIdUdlRERYa01USEVUdF9SLU5mdl9ZQmRpcE5DMUF5eXItNGYtYUFTZWFRUTFfcmtfb05vYl9QY2JyMVBxQTRaSDd0QmsxZ3JLeHptLW9hQTFrSjlTVWx6MTN5VGVCVUtGdTNGWVVlelhjQUdzMGJuQjkyQUtZcDFuOEU3cks4S0V2a2VhQzlrVm5RQkw0UmRwelJKaGtNOFFBbEdoWUV5WWZNak0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxOMzdkS3BzR2RJazg4RDV1WnFST1E3VHJycEJ5RzRnNVRWbmx0cDJuYUkzVUQyc3ZsSXNKcDZEc2dWOVE1Qk5vNm03TDlXX1haMUVEVXVBOTNva1l0SXJNb1hmSzFRM2czU09uTmlkdHV5LU9SVldrbWp6WmhObEo5aDdpanp3dnAwUW1hcjJ0NkI3amxYNTY2WW1ibDV2N0o4emtZ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary proceedings:</strong> Both Houses of Parliament faced repeated adjournments as the Opposition protested against the government, citing issues including the absence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah and alleged police brutality against students.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I35</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> The government introduced the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill and the Indian Statistical Institute Bill in the Lok Sabha, aiming to modernize legal frameworks and establish statutory authority for the institute.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQVTZBUld3b2Zua3M1TFBUT2o1czdpS0w2Wjdoc2xCTGMtRWRiZzQycmpQam5OV3l0LTREeENBU0tGM29UYkFpemJSUGtqUWFYampFZ1ZHcUtvZWhJZGdMWUJqbzhQdUM0WDRjNUpxT19LQnhvMTBka1pPNXpIUlpLdFRqTWV0ZWN5bkVXY3h4N0lGbXZjOUl2ZlZFQTcyc0l1UUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQaDhDcDNlZDVLelUzX2VvZEhnOWF5NHZIV2hweVY2Z2czRFJPTFVCUW9IUkt4NnVaU1lFMEF4VEFjOTFRVGdPSHg3Zld6WHp2QTR5S195anFFR2otbHFPYjFxVlY3ZDhoNkVJNE1Cd2dxLXZneE9tenB2WnBlY3R0VEIzelNWbG92Z2xzaTVxWUJUOVdJN05HOHFGRVNUMUdQWFdJRkd2b2wzWWloeFRfWTZmZXVHSG8?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I43</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>By-election outcomes:</strong> Prashant Kishor’s Jan Suraaj Party secured a historic victory in the Bankipur by-election, ending the BJP&#x27;s 31-year hold on the seat, while the Congress successfully retained the Datia constituency in Madhya Pradesh.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPOXZyMmx6UENyT2g4dmg5T3VlSTVTR25kOTNlelRzazU5aURKU2xGWVF2YmdienJ4a2p2SERSaHBqSHBjTW93dmZ5M3c5VXlINHFubmJvVjdKOHBEVU1CZjM3LVdYUDF1Ml81SXF1ZC1CQW1lZ2lWdjhyejA5ZS1BeVVQemM0TGN6WWQ5TjhfeEsySmtaOUxqRzJxa2JvM1Y4eDl5dWNHWWhOUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial relief for protesters:</strong> The Supreme Court clarified its order regarding student protesters, permitting state governments to withdraw FIRs filed against them to address concerns over criminal antecedents.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
